name: Venice.ai
summary: Privacy-first, uncensored inference platform running open-weight text, code, and image models with local browser chat storage and zero prompt logging.
ranking_rationale: Stands out for combining real no-log browser storage architecture with uncensored open-weight chat and image generation in one clean web UI.

pricing.free_tier: Generous daily free prompts for anonymous/free users
pricing.notes: Check venice.ai/pricing for current Pro monthly/annual plans and API token rates.

pros: Conversations stay stored locally in your browser rather than centralized servers
Uncensored open-weight text and image models under one clean web interface
Usable immediately on the free tier before creating an account
cons: Lacks dedicated roleplay character-card managers or lorebook systems like Chub/SpicyChat
Clearing browser site data deletes unbacked local chat threads

facts.value: Privacy-first uncensored AI chat & image generator
Prompt history kept client-side in browser storage; encrypted stateless inference
Curated open-weight LLMs (Dolphin/Llama/DeepSeek) and uncensored image models
